extracted.summary: Post-Matric Scholarship (PMS) for SC/ST/BC/Disabled Category, Telangana provides tuition fee reimbursement and monthly maintenance charges for eligible students from SC, ST, BC and Disabled categories pursuing higher education in Telangana.
extracted.amount_text: Reimbursement of tuition fees ranging from INR 850 for intermediate courses to INR 6,90,000 for medical courses per annum.
extracted.max_family_income_quote: The annual family income limit is INR 2,00,000 for the Scheduled Caste (SC/ST) category.
extracted.categories_quote: Applicants must belong to the SC, ST, BC, EBC or Disabled Welfare categories.
extracted.course_levels_quote: The program offers tuition fee reimbursement for intermediate, ITI, polytechnic, professional, graduate, postgraduate and Ph.D. courses.
extracted.states_quote: Applicants must be Indian nationals and Telangana domiciles.
